At Fragal Perfumes, your satisfaction matters. We offer a smooth and easy exchange process.

Exchange Eligibility:

  • You can request an exchange within 15 days of delivery.
  • The product must have at least 90% remaining, in its original condition and packaging.

Exchange Process:

  • To initiate an exchange, contact us on WhatsApp: +92 308 4456947.
  • Our team will guide you through the process.
  • Exchanges are usually processed within 7 working days after we receive the returned product.

Delivery Charges:

  • Customers are responsible for exchange delivery charges.
  • In case of a damaged, leaked or wrong product, we will cover all delivery costs.
